title: 橡树资本霍华德·马克斯：AI公司三年崛起，护城河还牢靠吗？
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: One of the things I'm writing a memo now about AI, I hope to have it out. I hope that maybe I'll get to finish it off here in Hong Kong. One of the questions I ask is if a company, like an anthropic,
segments.zh: 我正在写一篇关于AI的备忘录，希望能完成。也许能在香港写完。我问的一个问题是，如果一家像Anthropic这样的公司，

segments.en: can come from no place in three years, can another one supplant it in three years. I think that that's
segments.zh: 能在三年内从无到有，那么另一家能否在三年内取代它？我认为这是

segments.en: one of the things we have to think about. When you venture into the unknown, as I think we are
segments.zh: 我们必须考虑的问题之一。当你踏入未知领域，正如我认为我们在AI方面

segments.en: with AI, you have to just admit to yourself that there's a lot you don't know, and you have to
segments.zh: 所做的那样，你必须承认自己有很多不懂的地方，并且必须

segments.en: invest accordingly. If you have an investment opportunity which seems exciting on the surface, but where you have to say, I don't know the first thing about this really, then that should
segments.zh: 据此进行配置。如果你有一个表面上令人兴奋的配置机会，但你必须说，我对此一无所知，那么这应该

segments.en: influence how much money you put into it and in what way? Probably a need to rethink the concept of barriers to entry, because that seems to go pretty quick, and maybe it swings both ways.
segments.zh: 影响你投入多少资金以及以何种方式？可能需要重新思考进入壁垒的概念，因为它似乎变化很快，也许是把双刃剑。

segments.en: Can I just ask you about your wheelhouse, private credit. The deals seem to be just getting bigger.
segments.zh: 我能问问你的专长领域——私募信贷吗？交易规模似乎越来越大。
